author: val
body: Framebuffer pixels are B,G,R,X in memory order and poke-32 stores little-endian, so a 0xRRGGBB literal lands correctly.

author: val
body: Green is deliberately absent. The UEFI stub holds dark green while it runs, so a green screen already means the payload never reached its first rung, and a rung painting green would be indistinguishable from that.
